home.metaTitle: Lilium House — Refined Apartments in Rome and Crete
home.metaDescription: Lilium House offers refined apartments in Rome and Crete, designed for travelers seeking comfort, serenity, and an authentic sense of home.
home.title: A Home Between Rome and the Aegean
home.sub: Lilium House offers refined apartments in Rome and Crete, designed for travelers seeking comfort, serenity, and an authentic sense of home.
home.tileBookLabel: We typically respond within a few hours
home.tileCreteMeta: Sea, olive groves and open horizons
home.welcomeText: Whether you choose the timeless charm of Rome or the peaceful landscapes of Crete, each Lilium House apartment is carefully curated to offer a calm, elegant, and residential experience.
home.personalP1: Lilium House is not a hotel. It is a collection of homes created for those who value space, quiet, and authenticity. Each stay is designed to feel effortless, intimate, and deeply connected to its surroundings.
home.personalP2: From the natural light that fills each room to the carefully chosen furnishings and local touches, every detail has been considered to create an atmosphere of calm and understated elegance.
home.homesRomeText: A refined apartment in one of Rome's most elegant and residential districts.
home.homesCreteText: A peaceful home surrounded by nature, sea, and open horizons.
home.homesPrivacyText: Spaces designed for rest, independence, and long or short stays.
home.chooseRomeText: A calm and elegant apartment in the Aventino area, perfectly connected yet secluded from the city’s rush.
home.chooseCreteText: A serene house in Palekastro, ideal for slow living, nature, and sea-inspired days.
home.quote: A place that truly feels like home — calm, elegant, and deeply welcoming.

features.title: Residential, Not Hotel
features.text: Our homes are real residences, designed for living rather than brief overnight stays. Each space has a kitchen, a comfortable workspace, and room to breathe.

features.title: Natural Light & Space
features.text: Generous rooms filled with Mediterranean warmth and breathing room.

features.title: Calm Neighborhoods
features.text: Carefully chosen locations away from tourist crowds, close to real life.

features.title: Local Connection
features.text: Thoughtful recommendations to experience each place authentically.

features.title: Independent Living
features.text: Full kitchens, comfortable workspaces, and everything you need.

features.title: Slow Travel Philosophy
features.text: Designed for those who prefer depth over rushing through destinations.

rome.metaTitle: Lilium House Rome — Apartment in the Aventino District
rome.metaDescription: A warm and bright 45 sqm apartment in Rome’s elegant Aventino district, on Viale Giotto. Perfect for 3–5 guests, fully equipped kitchen, air-conditioning. Parking on request.
rome.title: Lilium House — Rome
rome.introText: A warm and bright 45 sqm apartment in Rome’s elegant Aventino district. Features a spacious bedroom with king-size bed, large living room with double sofa bed, fully equipped kitchen, and bathroom with washing machine. Air-conditioned with TV and hair dryer. Perfect for 3–5 guests. Parking available on request.
rome.expText: From ancient wonders to authentic trattorias, discover the best of the eternal city.

about.metaTitle: About — The Story of Lilium House
about.metaDescription: Lilium House was born from a simple idea: travel feels better when a place truly feels like home. A collection of homes in Rome and Crete shaped by calm, place, and personal travel.
about.title: The Story of Lilium House
about.sub: A collection of homes shaped by calm, place, and personal travel.
about.storyP1: Lilium House was born from a simple idea: travel feels better when a place truly feels like home. Each Lilium House property is designed as a personal space rather than an accommodation, offering comfort, privacy, and a strong connection to its surroundings.
about.storyP2: From the quiet streets of Rome’s Aventino district to the open landscapes of eastern Crete, Lilium House reflects a Mediterranean way of living — calm, authentic, and unhurried.
checkin: Suitable for short and long stays
about.contactTitle: For availability, questions, or special requests, feel free to contact us directly.

contact.metaDescription: Questions about our homes in Rome and Crete, availability, or what a stay with Lilium House looks like? Reach us on WhatsApp or by phone at +39 328 324 3518.
contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.sub: We’d love to hear from you. Whether you have questions about our homes, availability, or simply want to learn more about what a stay with Lilium House looks like — reach out anytime.

contact.romeText: A refined apartment in one of Rome's most elegant residential districts. Quiet, leafy, and perfectly connected to the city's highlights.
contact.creteText: A peaceful home in eastern Crete, surrounded by mountains, pristine beaches, and authentic Greek village life.
